releasePlan.notes: Flag gates the ENTER CALLSIGN login overlay (v1). Control path preserves original showOverlay() startup call. loginForm submit listener is attached unconditionally but is harmless when loginOverlay is hidden (control path). No prerequisites needed — login screen is self-contained. Guardrail metrics: ld_autogen__telemetry-default-error-rate (killswitch), ld_autogen__telemetry-lcp-average (pause — login overlay adds DOM; watch for LCP regression). Feature-scoped metrics are one-armed (v1-only path) so classified monitoring only.
